summary: CLEAN and TYPESET are decoupled at the render boundary. Four of five target modes execute for real and are proven by hermetic E2E tests (apenas_clean, traducao_clean, traducao_pronta/automatic, profissional/professional_qc). apenas_traducao (translate-only, no images) is honestly left executable=false because it needs a translation-data result contract across the YK-sensitive completion path -- not faked.

architecture.clean_independent: YES -- render(typeset=false) cleans without drawing text; works with translation disabled
architecture.typeset_independent: YES -- typeset path runs only when requested; consumes the cleaned buffer
architecture.clean_reused_for_typeset: YES -- typeset draws on the same `inpainted` buffer; no re-clean
architecture.source_immutable: YES -- clean/translated are separate artifacts; source never overwritten
architecture.safety_property: every gate keys off YOMU_EFFECTIVE_OPS, unset for legacy/automatic/professional jobs -> identical old code path (regression-proven)

code_changes: yomu/ocr/ocr_balloon.py: render_analyzed_image/_render_analyzed_image gain typeset=; when false, route cleanable groups through the existing clean-only path, final=inpainted, skip visual-diff.

yomu/pipeline/benchmark_pipeline.py: _plan_pipeline_flags() (env-derived gates); typeset threaded into both render sites; _persist_canonical_artifacts(typeset=) persists CLEAN only when no typeset; PDF build gated by want_pdf; _validate_quality(pdf_expected=); manifest requested_artifacts from the plan.
yomu/runtime/output_plan.py: plan_artifact_types(); executability updated -- translate+clean executable, translate-only still gated.
qc_changed: NO logic change; QC still built; clean-only may finish as review_required (success variant) -- noted as a product refinement, not a failure
retry_plan_preserved: YES -- the plan rides in job configuration (output_plan/effective_operations); retry reuses the same config
reexport_translation_reuse: unchanged -- persisted translation reused, 0 extra provider/YK (existing contract)
next_step: Either implement apenas_traducao (translation-data contract) or proceed to the UI preset mission -- the backend now executes the four main modes for real.
